# Elyst AI

> Elyst AI finds the work AI can do for a business, builds the AI system, and trains the team to use it. Based in Kozhikode, Kerala. Works with businesses across India and the GCC: in person in Kerala, Bengaluru and the UAE, online elsewhere.

## Direct answers

### What does Elyst AI do?

We find the work AI can do for you, build it, and train your people to use it.

### What is an AI system?

An AI system is software built around one repeat task in a business, such as drafting replies, checking documents or preparing reports. It does the repeat work, and the team checks the result and decides.

### Who owns the system afterwards?

The client does. Accounts and admin transfer at handover, so there is no lock-in.

### Where does Elyst AI work?

Across India and the GCC. Training is delivered in person in Kerala, Bengaluru and the UAE, and online when location is an issue.

## Services

- [AI Transformation](https://elystai.com/transformation): Six steps from first conversation to a trained team: we start with you, write a proposal, sit with the team, find where AI fits, build and test, then train the team. The client owns the system.
- [AI Kickstart](https://elystai.com/kickstart): Hands-on AI training built on a team's own work. One day, two half days, or a longer program. In person in Kerala, Bengaluru and the UAE, or online.

## Who it is for

- Growing businesses of roughly 10 to 30 people where one task costs time or leads and one person owns the change.
- For training: functional teams, managers, department heads, business leaders, and HR and L&D teams.

## Case studies

- [Nalakath Holdings](https://elystai.com/work/nalakath-holdings-ai-content-system): An AI content system for four group companies in Kerala. AI Transformation.
- [Arvind Fashions](https://elystai.com/work/arvind-fashions-ai-training): Full-day AI training for about 50 people in Bengaluru. AI Kickstart.
- [Kalyan Tourism and Travel](https://elystai.com/work/kalyan-ai-onboarding-system): An AI onboarding system, built in Dubai, that replaced manual document checks. AI Transformation.
- [Autobahn Corp](https://elystai.com/work/autobahn-ai-training-for-hr): Full-day AI training for about 40 HR professionals in Kochi. AI Kickstart.
